Not direct replacements under current bit-exact Math contract; no assertion weakening or package change

capabilities.probe: Zero mismatches on initial probe only

adversarial_review: Use package commit rather than newer dirty tensor checkout
Do not equate a public method inside an internal type with a callable public API
Count data gathering, history copying and output conversion in end-to-end costs
Preserve recurrence dependencies and exact rounding
Verify generated code and actual call-path reachability
Measure native gaps separately from old/new improvements
Reject an unpromising diagnostic before spending a full qualification cycle
